mission.title: Scene of the Crime
mission.description: Investigate a mysterious incident and track down the missing witness.

phase.briefing:
Greetings, operative. There is an unfortunate situation developing which warrants your involvement.
An incident has occurred. The nature of the incident remains uncertain. Proceed to the location indicated, investigate the site, and interview any survivors.

enter.say: Incident? Survivors? Be careful in there, {player}.

done.say: Dead bodies, but no signs of violence...
This is too creepy. Make sure you get a good look at the whole scene before you leave!

complete.say: I hate to say it, but... it sounds like those people woke up in their pods. I wouldn't wish that on anyone.

phase.briefing:
According to the events described by those witnesses, it would seem that some party has set off a code bomb in the building.
Code bombs were once used by certain... extremist Zion elements. They expose the true nature of the Matrix to those unprepared to accept it. Such activities were thought to be over for some time now. Apparently, we were in error.
We are interested in discovering the identity of the missing witness described by that bluepill; the man dressed something like a priest. We have found a match in the local surveillance reports. Proceed to the next location and find him.

enter.say:
"Extremist Zion elements"? I think we both know who he's talking about...
Anyhow, keep a low profile in here until you've got a solid lead.

done.say: Yikes. At least we know he was here.

phase.briefing:
How unpleasant. Humans sometimes tend to make terrible messes of themselves.
Regardless, the story of that witness is corroborated by further surveillance evidence. A man was seen fleeing the area while you were inside the building.
It is beginning to look like the missing witness is trying to... escape investigation. Proceed carefully, operative.

enter.say: I guess the guy ran in here... keep an eye out, {player}!

done.say: Damn it! Empty... Better get out and talk to Gray.

mission.finish:
How... intriguing. The man you were chasing has seemingly disappeared. I believe we can safely say that he has moved from being a witness to being a... suspect.
Remain in contact, {player}.
